costLevels.text: Cheapest: free models only; heavy pre-processing chains/workers first
Cheap: free + local OpenCode (7B on Lenovo / Grok Bot box), workers and pre-processing chains
Balanced: local/free by default; escalate to Codex/Grok Build only if the user asks
Generous: Codex, Grok Build and Grok Imagine allowed when they clearly help
Most expensive: prefer the strongest executors (Codex, Grok Build/Imagine) for speed and quality
